timeline.content: Founded FAVE Vietnam in Hanoi, starting with HVAC system maintenance and repair.
Expanded into HVAC installation for high-rise office buildings and apartments.
Signed partnerships with world-leading HVAC manufacturers, enhancing product and service quality.
Successfully completed large-scale HVAC projects for industrial zones in Bac Ninh, Hung Yen, and Hai Phong.
Achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification for quality management systems. Team surpassed 100 engineers and technicians.
Completed over 500 projects, establishing position as one of the top HVAC companies in Northern Vietnam.
